zh: 宝宝昨晚没睡好，今天一直哭。
old_en: The baby didn't sleep well last night, so he has been crying all day.
new_en: The baby didn't sleep well last night and has been crying all day.

zh: 昨天晚上小家伙没怎么睡觉，今天精神可差了。
old_en: The little one didn't sleep much last night, so he looks really tired today.
new_en: The little one didn't sleep much last night, so he looks really tired today.

zh: 几点来接孩子放学呢？
old_en: What time are you coming to pick up the child after school?
new_en: What time will you pick up the child after school?

zh: 明天几点来幼儿园接我？
old_en: What time should I expect you to come and pick me up from kindergarten tomorrow?
new_en: What time are you coming to pick me up from kindergarten tomorrow?

zh: 老师，宝宝在班上表现怎么样？
old_en: Teacher, how is the baby doing in class?
new_en: Teacher, how is the baby doing in class?

zh: 孩子在幼儿园里和其他小朋友相处得好吗？
old_en: Does the child get along well with other kids at the kindergarten?
new_en: Does the child get along well with other kids at kindergarten?

zh: 这孩子吃饭总是挑食。
old_en: This kid always picks what he wants to eat.
new_en: This child is always a picky eater.

zh: 怎么哄都不肯吃饭，这可怎么办。
old_en: No matter what I try, he won't eat, what should I do?
new_en: No matter what I do, he won't eat. What should I do?

zh: 阿姨可以帮忙临时照看宝宝吗？
old_en: Can the aunt help watch the baby for a while?
new_en: Can the nanny help watch the baby for a while?

zh: 邻居姐姐能帮我照看一下孩子吗？
old_en: Can my neighbor's sister watch my child for me?
new_en: Can my neighbor's daughter watch my child for me?

zh: 宝宝最近学会了自己穿鞋。
old_en: The baby recently learned to put on shoes by himself.
new_en: The baby has recently learned to put on shoes by himself.

zh: 孩子最近能自己用勺子吃饭了。
old_en: The child can now use a spoon to eat by himself recently.
new_en: The child can now eat with a spoon independently.

zh: 给孩子报名了画画班。
old_en: I signed the kid up for an art class.
new_en: I signed the kid up for an art class.

zh: 我想给小孩报名一个音乐班。
old_en: I want to sign the kid up for a music class.
new_en: I want to sign the kid up for a music class.

zh: 孩子发烧了，需要请一天假。
old_en: The kid has a fever and needs to take a day off.
new_en: The kid has a fever and needs to take a day off.

zh: 宝宝肚子疼，今天不能去幼儿园了。
old_en: The baby has a tummy ache, so we can't go to kindergarten today.
new_en: The baby has a tummy ache, so we can't go to kindergarten today.

zh: 我规定每天晚上九点睡觉。
old_en: I set a rule that we go to bed at nine every night.
new_en: I have a rule that bedtime is at nine every night.

zh: 我们家的规矩是吃完饭要刷碗。
old_en: Our family rule is to wash the dishes after dinner.
new_en: Our family rule is to wash the dishes after dinner.

zh: 周末约其他家长去公园玩。
old_en: Let's meet other parents in the park this weekend.
new_en: I arranged to meet other parents at the park this weekend.

zh: 下周三下午一起去图书馆。
old_en: We'll go to the library together next Wednesday afternoon.
new_en: We will go to the library together next Wednesday afternoon.
